title: Curey Healthcare App
description: Graduation project focused on backend API and database systems
extendedDescription: My graduation project focused on designing and implementing robust backend APIs and database systems, emphasizing scalability, security, and efficient data management. I structured the API to support clean integration with various front-end clients, while the database architecture was optimized for performance and reliability. Through this project, I gained hands-on experience with system design principles, API lifecycle management, and data modeling, resulting in a solid and well-documented backend foundation.
